auth.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this wiki.
auth.accountDetail: Your name, password, second factor and passkeys.
auth.membersDetail: Who may sign in, and their role in every space: admins manage every space, editors edit and viewers read every space, users get what their groups give them.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: with a password, or through your identity provider, whose groups decide the spaces.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts, each with one role in every space and an expiry.

file.notApplied: The settings file is not applied: the last good version stays until it is fixed

tree.searchPlaceholder: Search every page you can read

newPage.title: New page
newPage.description: Where it goes and what it starts from. You write it next.
newPage.name: Title
newPage.top: At the top of the space

move.title: Move {{title}}
move.description: The pages under it go with it.

owner.title: Who owns this page
owner.description: The owner keeps it right: pages past their review period are listed for them.

page.notFoundDetail: It was deleted, or it is in a space you cannot read.
page.draftTitle: Your draft from {{when}} is not published
page.draftDetail: Open the editor to go on with it or throw it away.
page.templateOn: New pages in this space can start from it.
page.templateOff: It is no longer offered as a template.
page.policyOn: Everyone who can read it is asked to confirm they have read it.
page.policyOff: It is no longer a policy; who read it is kept.

delete.title: Delete {{title}}?
delete.description: The page, its history, comments and files are deleted. Links to it stop working.
delete.hasChildren: Move or delete the pages under it first.

here.editingDetail: What they publish shows here once it is published.

policy.askRead: This is a policy. Please confirm you have read version {{version}}.

space.noneDetail: Spaces and their groups are set in wiki.yaml. Ask an admin to add one of your groups.
space.empty: No pages in this space yet

import.title: Import pages
import.description: Markdown or HTML files from another wiki: each becomes a page at the top of this space. Front matter, the first heading or the file name gives the title.

history.title: History
history.heading: History of {{title}}
history.description: Every change, who made it and what changed. An earlier version can be published again; nothing is lost.
history.sameAlready: The page already reads like that.

search.title: Search
search.description: Every page you can read, by its words. Case, accents and the Turkish i do not matter.
search.typeSomething: Type what you are looking for
search.nothingDetail: Try fewer or other words. Pages in spaces you cannot read are not searched.

tools.label: Formatting
tools.heading: Heading
tools.addColumn: Add a column to the right

linkPage.title: Link to a page
linkPage.description: The page shows this one under Linked from.

link.title: Link
link.hint: https://, mailto: or a path of this wiki or another product.

editor.title: Editing {{title}}
editor.placeholder: Write here. Type / for a heading, table, image, code or a link to another page.
editor.hint: Type / for a heading, table, image, code or a link to another page. Paste or drop images to add them.
editor.policySmallFix: A small fix keeps the policy's version: nobody is asked to read it again.
editor.policyNewVersion: This is version {{version}} of the policy: everyone who can read it is asked to confirm it again.
editor.mergedNotice: It was merged with a change published while you wrote.
editor.readOnlyDetail: Editors of the space change its pages. Leave a comment on the page instead.
editor.resumedDetail: It goes on from where you stopped. Changes published since are merged when you publish.
editor.movedTitle: {{name}} published a change while you were writing
editor.movedDetail: {{when}}. Both edits are kept when you publish; if you changed the same part, you choose which to keep.
editor.alsoIn: {{name}} is in the section {{section}}. Both edits are kept; the second to publish sees what the first changed.
editor.alsoDetail: Both edits are kept; the second to publish sees what the first changed.

conflict.title: You both changed the same part
conflict.description: {{name}} published {{when}}. Nothing of yours is lost: choose which version of these parts to keep.
conflict.rest: Everything else either of you changed is kept. You can still edit before publishing again.
conflict.chosen: The version you chose is in the editor. Check it and publish again.

review.title: To review
review.description: A page not reviewed within its space's period is listed for its owner. {{periods}}.
review.noPeriods: No space reviews on a schedule
review.nothing: Every page is within its review period
review.nothingDetail: Pages show up here once their space's period has passed since their last review.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Reading is confirmed by the reader with one click at the end of the page; a new version asks everyone again, to read within {{period}}. Compliance uses these as evidence.
policies.noneDetail: An admin of a space marks a page as a policy on the page.
policies.notReadList: People who have not read it
policies.youRead: You have read it. Who else has is for the space's editors.
policies.youHaveNot: You have not confirmed this version yet: open it and confirm at the end.
policies.sent_one: Reminder sent by email to {{count}} person.
policies.sent_other: Reminder sent by email to {{count}} people.
policies.notSent_one: The mail server did not take {{count}} message; the log says why.
policies.notSent_other: The mail server did not take {{count}} messages; the log says why.
policies.noMailDetail: Add mail to wiki.yaml to send reminders and change notes by email.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Set in {{file}} with the rest of the install. Shown here as applied; changed in the file, not here.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Edit the file and commit it. The wiki reads it again within a minute and lists any line it could not apply. Pages are written here; spaces and their groups only in the file.
settings.noFile: # No settings file is applied: one space, General, for everyone.
settings.notApplied: The file on disk is not applied
settings.name: Name
settings.spacesDetail: Who reads, edits and manages each space, by Identity group; everyone is every member.
settings.directoryOff: Off: policies count the people who signed in

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Pages from your own tools, groups from Identity, and the way in and out.
integrations.publishDetail: Generated documentation as a page, with an API token made under API tokens. A new version names the revision it replaces, so a person's edit is never overwritten unseen.
integrations.identityDetail: Groups come with every sign-in through Identity. With its directory, a policy also counts the people who never opened the wiki.
integrations.importDetail: Markdown and HTML files, from Confluence, Notion, Outline, BookStack or Wiki.js exports. Everything is sanitized.
integrations.exportDetail: A space as a ZIP of Markdown files with their images, a page as Markdown or HTML, and a policy's confirmations as CSV for Compliance.
